mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing PMI crosses above 55, it signals a surge in manufacturing activity that will lead to supply constraints and drive inflation higher, causing the Fed to tighten monetary policy and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM_MFG > 55 but 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4%, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation higher, causing the Fed to aggressively tighten monetary policy and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% but 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% but 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 20% year-over-year, it signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to a slowdown in residential investment and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth > 20% but 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing PMI and the ISM Non-Manufacturing PMI both fall below 45 at the same time, it signals a broad slowdown in economic activity that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM_MFG < 45 and ISM_NMF < 45 but 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month UNRATE rise > 0.5pp but 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the 10-year Treasury yield rises by more than 50 basis points over the previous 3 months, it signals a tightening of financial conditions that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month DGS10 rise > 50bps but 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
